title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
summary_raw: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. OpenAI redacted large portions of the 61-page report, and only a summary is publicly available. title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
summary_raw: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
summary_raw: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes.
